title: Planul general de conturi contabile
notes: Chapter II (the nomenclature) as restated by OMF 100/2019 and amended by OMF 171/2019, in force from 1 January 2020, transcribed from the Ministry of Finance's consolidated text. Each account's nature (activ or pasiv, and whether it is rectificativ, de calculație or de colectare – repartizare) is from its own sentence in chapter III where there is one, from the opening of classes 6 and 7 otherwise, and from chapter I's general rule for the three accounts that state none (172, 262, 344). OMF 111/2021 is read: it changed only correspondent accounts in the descriptions of 143, 254 and 316, nothing this file holds. Not yet read: OMF 135/2019 (amends OMF 188/2014; legis.md has no page of its own for it, so its effect has to be read from 188/2014's consolidated text). Abrogated in 2019 and so absent: accounts 312 and 413, subaccount 7143. Names keep the act's spelling (î, "sînt"); the PDF's cedilla ş and ţ are written as ș and ț.
